title: Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots - Old Snake Smoking (Install Animation)
description:
A customizable wallpaper based on the installation screen in Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots (MGS4). Extraneous visual elements (i.e. the logo, clock, and gameplay tips) can be individually configured and/or disabled.

[h1]----- UPDATES -----[/h1]
[h3]February 23, 2025:[/h3]
• Added support for 4K displays
• Added 'Old Snake' music loop

I've updated the wallpaper with 4K quality visuals. Also, by popular demand, I've included the 'Old Snake' music as well... even though it was only played on the title screen, not the install screen. Mandela Effect?

I had planned to include support for Ultrawide monitors as well, but it's proving to be difficult to capture footage at the necessary resolution without significant frame loss. I'll keep working on it, but it may have to wait until I can upgrade my PC. I've also seen requests for a mobile version, so I'll look into that as well.

Thanks again for your patience and support, everyone!
